initialize.instructions: Create clips with submit_video (or create_upload_link, then submit_uploaded_video), poll get_job, then call list_clips. Only submit_video, submit_uploaded_video and create_thumbnail_job spend credits (not refunded). Confirm with the user before those, before set_caption_style or recaption_clip (they overwrite a clip) and before post_clip (it publishes). Use only projects the connected account owns. post_clip posts right away; scheduling posts, timeline edits and connecting social accounts are done in the FrameOS web app, not here.

tools.description: Submit a public video link for AI clipping: FrameOS downloads it and starts a render job (poll get_job). Only for videos the user owns or has the rights to use. Spends 1 credit per source minute, rounded up, once the clips are saved; not refunded, and a failed run costs nothing. A link still rendering returns its job; one whose last run failed, stopped or stalled is re-run in that project, replacing its settings and, on success, its clips; a finished one makes a new project, charged again. A refused start still leaves a failed project. max_clips is 1 to 20 (default 3), an upper limit: a video with fewer strong moments can return fewer. focus_prompt is an optional steer of up to 1000 characters; only its first 400 characters are used.
tools.name: submit_video
tools.title: Submit Video

tools.description: List clipping projects owned by the connected FrameOS account, newest first (limit up to 50, offset to page), with each one's status, progress and clip count. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits.
tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List Projects

tools.description: Get the status and summary of one FrameOS clipping project: status, progress, source link (null for an uploaded file) and clip count. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits.
tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get Project

tools.description: Check a job's progress using the job ID from submit_video, submit_uploaded_video, export_clip, export_collection, recaption_clip or post_clip: returns its state, progress, message, ETA and any result. Read-only and safe to poll: it never starts, changes or charges anything.
tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Get Job

tools.description: List a project's clips: titles, scores, transcripts, timings and media links. If exportRequired is true, call export_clip for the captioned download. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits. Media links are signed URLs that expire in about an hour and work for anyone who has them.
tools.name: list_clips
tools.title: List Clips

tools.description: Show the connected FrameOS workspace's name, plan and credit balance. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits. The balance can be up to a minute old and doesn't subtract credits held for renders still running.
tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Whoami

tools.description: Read the workspace's recent credit usage (its 10 newest charges from the last 30 days, plus 30-day totals) and current credit balance. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits. Preview images are signed URLs that expire in about an hour and work for anyone who has them.
tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Get Usage

tools.description: Read one clip's title, score, transcript, aspect, layout, preview, and export requirement. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits. Media links are signed URLs that expire in about an hour and work for anyone who has them.
tools.name: describe_clip
tools.title: Describe Clip

tools.description: Read a page or time range of the full source-video transcript. start_ms and end_ms are in milliseconds; the returned segments' start and end are in seconds. limit is up to 500 segments per page (default 100). New renders store this artifact; older projects may lack it. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits.
tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get Transcript

tools.description: Read the workspace's default brand template: its logo (corner, size, opacity) and, on paid plans, its caption default. On paid plans, videos submitted here use that logo, caption default and content type (the shape comes from aspect_ratio); with no default, or on the free plan, no template is applied. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits. logoUrl is a signed URL that expires in about an hour and works for anyone who has it.
tools.name: get_brand
tools.title: Get Brand

tools.description: Export a clip as a captioned MP4 and return a signed download link (it expires in about an hour and works for anyone who has it). If that file isn't rendered yet, this starts an export job that saves a new MP4 in FrameOS storage: poll get_job, then call again for the link. A call while that job is still running returns the same job. Uses no credits and never changes the clip; style and filename apply to this download only.
tools.name: export_clip
tools.title: Export Clip

tools.description: Create a separate clip record using the same rendered media, without charging or re-rendering: the copy appears in the same project with (Copy) added to its title, and the original is unchanged. Each call adds another copy, so a retry after success leaves an extra clip.
tools.name: duplicate_clip
tools.title: Duplicate Clip

tools.description: List clip collections in the connected FrameOS workspace, newest first, with each one's id, name, creation time and clip count. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits.
tools.name: list_collections
tools.title: List Collections

tools.description: Create a named workspace collection for organizing clips (name 1 to 120 characters, unique in the workspace); it starts empty and uses no credits. A name already in use is refused and nothing new is created, so a repeat call changes nothing; use list_collections to find it. Collections can't be renamed or deleted here.
tools.name: create_collection
tools.title: Create Collection

tools.description: Add an owned clip to an owned collection; repeated calls do not create duplicates (added is false if it was already there). The clip itself is not changed and no credits are used. Clips can't be removed from a collection here, and export_collection only exports collections of up to 50 clips.
tools.name: add_clip_to_collection
tools.title: Add Clip To Collection

tools.description: List clips in a workspace collection, in the order they were added, with fresh preview URLs. If exportRequired is true, call export_clip for the captioned download. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits. Media links are signed URLs that expire in about an hour and work for anyone who has them.
tools.name: list_clips_in_collection
tools.title: List Clips In Collection

tools.description: Export each clip in a collection (up to 50; larger collections are refused) as a captioned MP4 in its saved style. Ready clips return signed download links (about an hour); the others start export jobs that save new MP4s in FrameOS storage. Each call keeps at most 10 clips rendering; clips with status not_started need another call once those finish. A clip already rendering returns its running job. Uses no credits and never changes the clips.
tools.name: export_collection
tools.title: Export Collection

tools.description: Create a one-hour signed PUT URL for a video file: each call opens a new, empty slot in this workspace's private FrameOS storage and returns upload_url and gs_path. Upload the bytes to upload_url, then call submit_uploaded_video with gs_path. Uses no credits and can't overwrite existing files; anyone holding upload_url can upload to that slot until it expires.
tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.title: Create Upload Link

tools.description: Start clipping a file from create_upload_link by its gs_path: starts a render job (poll get_job). Spends 1 credit per source minute, rounded up, once the clips are saved; not refunded, and a failed run costs nothing. Once it succeeds FrameOS deletes the uploaded file (clips stay), so the gs_path can't be reused. A repeat while it renders returns its job; after a failed, stopped or stalled run it re-runs that project, replacing its settings. A refused start still leaves a failed project. max_clips is 1 to 20 (default 3), an upper limit: a video with fewer strong moments can return fewer. focus_prompt is an optional steer of up to 1000 characters; only its first 400 characters are used.
tools.name: submit_uploaded_video
tools.title: Submit Uploaded Video

tools.description: Change an overlay clip's saved caption style and optional appearance (font, scale, yPct, anim); export uses the new look. This overwrites the saved style, and leaving out appearance clears earlier appearance overrides; the old settings are not kept. Nothing is rendered and no credits are used. A burned-caption clip is refused: use recaption_clip.
tools.name: set_caption_style
tools.title: Set Caption Style

tools.description: Change a clip's caption style; uses no credits. An older burned-caption clip is re-rendered: you get a job to poll with get_job; when it finishes the clip's video is replaced by the new render and the clip switches to overlay captions, and a repeat call before then starts another re-render. For an overlay clip the style is saved right away, overwriting the old one (leaving out appearance clears earlier overrides), and there is no job (job_id is null); export_clip renders it.
tools.name: recaption_clip
tools.title: Recaption Clip

tools.description: Generate 1 to 3 thumbnails (max_thumbnails, default 3; a larger number makes 3) from one source: clip_id or video_id for media already in FrameOS (video_id re-downloads that project's original; use clip_id for uploads), or a public http(s) video url; style_ref is an optional public image link to match. FrameOS downloads these links; gs:// paths and local files are rejected. Only for videos the user owns or has the rights to use. Spends 10 credits per thumbnail made, when the job succeeds; not refunded, fewer are made if the balance is short, and a failed job costs nothing. Every call, retries included, is a new paid job. Returns a job ID for get_thumbnail_job.
tools.name: create_thumbnail_job
tools.title: Create Thumbnail Job

tools.description: Check a thumbnail job's progress and result images, using the job ID from create_thumbnail_job. Read-only and safe to poll: it never starts, changes or charges anything. Image links were signed when the job finished and expire in about an hour; list_thumbnails returns fresh ones.
tools.name: get_thumbnail_job
tools.title: Get Thumbnail Job

tools.description: List generated thumbnails in the connected workspace, newest first (limit 1 to 100, default 30), each with view and download links. Read-only: changes nothing and uses no credits. Media links are signed URLs that expire in about an hour and work for anyone who has them.
tools.name: list_thumbnails
tools.title: List Thumbnails

tools.description: List social publishing accounts already connected to the FrameOS workspace (YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn), with each account's id for post_clip and whether it needs reconnecting. Read-only: it doesn't connect, change or contact any account, and uses no credits.
tools.name: list_social_accounts
tools.title: List Social Accounts

tools.description: Draft a title, caption and hashtags for one clip from its transcript; tone is an optional steer of up to 100 characters. Read-only: it only returns the draft; nothing is saved or posted and no credits are used. To write it, FrameOS sends the clip's title, transcript and tone to a third-party AI provider; wording can differ between calls. Each workspace gets 30 drafts an hour, retries and failed attempts included. A clip with no transcript is refused; post_clip can't publish to TikTok or X.
tools.name: generate_social_copy
tools.title: Generate Social Copy

tools.description: Publish a clip as a new post on a connected social account. Call only when the user explicitly asks to publish: once started it can't be cancelled or taken down from FrameOS. Returns a job ID: poll get_job; when it completes its message is the public post URL. Every call posts again: don't retry, even after a timeout or failed job, until the user checks the account. privacy (default public) is honoured on YouTube only (uploads are marked not made for kids): on Facebook, private uploads the video unpublished and unlisted posts it publicly; Instagram and LinkedIn posts are always public.
tools.name: post_clip
tools.title: Post Clip
